title: Volleyball: FEU clinch V-League semis ticket with sweep of La Salle
summary: Far Eastern University is headed to the semifinals of the 2026 V-League Collegiate Challenge after a 25–23, 25–19, 25–18 sweep of De La Salle University on Saturday.
